page.notes: The italic opening is a quotation of Judges 14 in the printer's Latin. The first word is a fragment at the top of the page; "vefles" is set with long s and read as "vestes". The line "quae nihil aliud sunt..." is underlined in the print and is transcribed as underlined. "celebrari" is uncertain: the abbreviation is unclear. "Iud. 14" is doubtful. The page ends on the half word "vr"; the catchword "be" is the start of the next word. The top-left page number is hard to read.
